title: 第1章 李衍道第2章 家族困境
content_zh:
琉璃群岛，位处玄风界东部，由上百座大小不一的岛屿组成。
在这众多岛屿之中，有一座名为风林岛存在，这里是修仙家族李家的基业所在。
风林岛仅有方圆三公里大小。
岛屿地形东高西低，东方耸立着数座秀美的小山峰。
山腹之中蕴含着丰富的地下水源，涓涓细流自岩石缝隙间悄然涌出，蜿蜒流淌。
最终汇入岛屿西侧，形成一条条小型的溪流。
李家族人牵引这些溪流，在每一处水流汇集之处开辟出若干小型湖泊。
而每个湖泊之下，皆藏有一个小小的灵穴。
每日自灵穴深处缓缓涌出的灵气，数量从一缕至十缕不等。
也正是这些湖泊的存在，李家精心培育了一种名为“胖头鲤”的灵鱼。
这种灵鱼属于一阶下品，其肉质鲜美无比，经过五年的细心照料便可长成。
届时捕捞出售，市场上每条胖头鲤的价格约为一到两块灵石，成为了李家最重要的产业之一。
李家在风林岛上所拥有的湖泊中，养育了上百条体态圆润的胖头鲤。
每年，他们都会择机捕捞一部分灵鱼送往坊市交易。
不仅为家族带来了稳定的收入，更使得李家每年能积累数十枚珍贵的灵石。
正是依靠这些灵石的积累，李家逐渐壮大，成为了一个拥有八位炼气期修士的小型修仙家族。
家族老祖李松鹤，达到了炼气大圆满之境。
深知自己难以突破至筑基期，早在数十年前，当他踏入炼气后期后，便萌生了创立修仙家族的想法。
李松鹤广泛纳妾，最终有幸诞下了四位具有灵根的后代——李林楠、李林一、李林燕以及李林风。
除了李林燕和李林风以外，其余两人均迎娶了诸多凡尘中的女子，延续血脉，繁衍后代。

如今，李家已迎来了第三代修士，即李衍云、李衍道和李衍胜三位年轻族人。
李松鹤作为家族的创始人，连同林字辈的四位核心成员，以及衍字辈的三位新生力量，共同构筑起了李家这一修仙家族的基础。
在这座风林岛上，除了八位炼气修士外，还存在着一个小型的村镇。
这里居住着大量的李家凡人及其家眷，总人数约有一千余人。
除了李家的族人外，还有许多来自周边岛屿的凡人。
他们或是因缘际会，或是被招揽至此，共同生活在这个与世隔绝的小镇之中。
岛屿的南端，一座幽静的小山峰之上，一位面容清秀的青年正端坐于蒲团之上，沉浸在修行当中。
青年名叫李衍道，是李家衍字辈排行第二的修士。
随着体内完成了一个大周天的运转，他缓缓吐出一口浊气，双眸渐渐睁开，眼中闪过一抹精光。
“从我胎穿到这个世界已经过去了十五年。
自八岁那年被检测出拥有灵根以来，我已经修炼了整整七年。
content_en:
The Liuli Islands are located in the eastern part of the Xuanfeng Realm and are composed of hundreds of islands of various sizes.
Among these many islands, there is one called Fenglin Island, which is where the foundation of the Li family, a cultivating immortal family, lies.
Fenglin Island is only three kilometers in diameter.
The terrain of the island is high in the east and low in the west, with several beautiful small peaks standing in the east.
There is a rich underground water source in the heart of the mountain. A trickle of water quietly gushes out from the cracks in the rocks and flows meanderingly.
Eventually it merges into the west side of the island, forming small streams.
The Li family members channeled these streams and created several small lakes where the water flow converged.
Under each lake, there is a small spiritual cave.
The number of spiritual energy that slowly gushes out from the depths of the spiritual cave every day ranges from one to ten strands.
It is precisely because of the existence of these lakes that the Li family carefully cultivated a kind of spiritual fish called "Fat-headed Carp".
This kind of spiritual fish belongs to the first-order low-grade. Its meat is extremely delicious and can be grown after five years of careful care.
When the fish is caught and sold, the price of each fat-headed carp on the market is about one to two spiritual stones, making it one of the most important industries of the Li family.
The Li family has raised hundreds of fat-headed carp in the lake they own on Fenglin Island.
Every year, they would choose an opportunity to catch some spiritual fish and send them to the market for trading.
Not only does it bring a stable income to the family, but it also allows the Li family to accumulate dozens of precious spiritual stones every year.
Relying on the accumulation of these spiritual stones, the Li family gradually grew and became a small immortal cultivating family with eight monks in the Qi refining stage.
Li Songhe, the ancestor of the family, has reached the state of perfect Qi refining.
Knowing that it would be difficult for him to break through to the foundation building stage, decades ago, when he entered the late stage of Qi refining, he came up with the idea of ​​establishing an immortal cultivating family.
Li Songhe took concubines extensively, and was eventually lucky enough to give birth to four offspring with spiritual roots - Li Linnan, Li Linyi, Li Linyan and Li Linfeng.
Except for Li Linyan and Li Linfeng, the other two married many women in the mortal world to continue their bloodline and reproduce their offspring.
Today, the Li family has welcomed the third generation of monks, namely three young clan members: Li Yanyun, Li Yandao and Li Yansheng.
As the founder of the family, Li Songhe, together with the four core members of the Lin generation and the three new forces of the Yan generation, jointly built the foundation of the Li family, a family that cultivates immortality.
On this Fenglin Island, in addition to the eight Qi Refining monks, there is also a small village.
There are a large number of Li family members and their families living here, with a total number of about a thousand people.
In addition to the members of the Li family, there are also many mortals from surrounding islands.
They either met by chance or were recruited here to live together in this isolated town.
At the southern end of the island, on a quiet mountain peak, a young man with a delicate face was sitting on a futon, immersed in practice.
The young man's name is Li Yandao, and he is the second-ranked monk in Li Jiayan's generation.
As his body completed a great cycle, he slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, his eyes gradually opened, and a flash of light flashed in his eyes.
"Fifteen years have passed since I was born into this world.
I have been practicing for seven years since I was diagnosed with spiritual roots when I was eight years old.
